column3: a Non-U.S. Note Owner who is a nonresident alien or foreign corporation will not be subject to U.S. federal income tax on gain realized on the sale, exchange or redemption of such Note provided that (i) such gain is not effectively  connected to a trade or business carried on by the Non-U.S. Note Owner in the United States, (ii) in the case of a Non-U.S. Note Owner that is an individual, such individual neither is present in the United States for 183 days or more during  the taxable year in which such sale, exchange or redemption occurs, nor ceased being a U.S. citizen or long-term resident for tax avoidance purposes and (iii) in the case of gain representing accrued interest, the conditions described in  clause (a) are satisfied; and
